name: vexrec 0.1.0: Modern and Minimalistic Linux Screen Recorder and Screenshot Suite
body:
# vexrec 0.1.0

Modern and minimalistic Linux screen recorder and screenshot suite for high-performance capture workflows.

### Highlights
- Direct X11 and Wayland native capture via PipeWire and XDG Desktop Portal
- Hardware-accelerated video encoding pipelines (VA-API and NVENC) with low-overhead software fallbacks
- Multi-source audio loopback mixing and microphone synchronization
- Draggable webcam Picture-in-Picture (PiP) overlay
- Native Debian packaging, universal installation script, and shell autocompletions
